subtopics.title: The Public Sector, the Budget and Fiscal Policy

questions.question: The five macroeconomic objectives of the public sector are growth, full employment, price stability, economic equity and:
options: Exchange rate stability with balance of payments equilibrium

questions.question: The Medium Term Expenditure Framework is:
options: The rolling three-year government spending plan

questions.question: On the Laffer curve, pushing the tax rate beyond the optimal point causes:
options: Total tax revenue to FALL, because incentives to work and invest shrink

questions.question: Which list contains ONLY reasons for public sector failure?
options: Bureaucracy, political interference, apathy and special interest groups

subtopics.title: Foreign Exchange Markets and the Balance of Payments

questions.question: A foreign company buying JSE shares is recorded in the balance of payments as:
options: Portfolio investment in the financial account
Net gold exports in the current account

questions.question: South African importers buy more from abroad. On the market for dollars this:
options: Shifts the supply of dollars right and strengthens the rand
Shifts the demand for dollars right, so the dollar costs more rands and the rand depreciates

questions.question: The terms of trade are calculated as:
options: The index of export prices divided by the index of import prices, times 100

questions.question: Devaluation, as opposed to depreciation, happens when:
options: Market forces weaken a floating currency
The authorities lower the value of a currency under a FIXED exchange rate system

questions.question: The infant industry argument is used to justify:
options: Temporary protection for young local industries until they can compete

questions.question: Economic growth differs from economic development because:
options: Growth is the rise in real GDP, while development is the broader improvement in living standards and choices
Development is measured only in rands
Growth includes education and health outcomes

questions.question: Coega and East London are examples of:
options: Industrial Development Zones, later folded into the Special Economic Zone programme

questions.question: Which of the following is a SOCIAL indicator rather than an economic one?
options: Access to clean water and sanitation
